program.bidang_kerja: Asistensi penelitian biomedis dan kesehatan; edukasi serta komunikasi kesehatan; administrasi program kesehatan nonklinis. Untuk bekerja sebagai dokter diperlukan pendidikan Profesi Dokter dan pemenuhan persyaratan praktik.
program.bidang_kerja_en: Biomedical and health research assistance; health education and communication; administration of non-clinical health programmes. Working as a medical doctor requires the Professional Medical Doctor programme and meeting the practice requirements.

cpl.isi: 1. Mampu melaksanakan praktik kedokteran yang profesional sesuai dengan nilai dan prinsip ke-Tuhanan, moral luhur, etika, disiplin, hukum, sosial budaya dan agama dalam konteks lokal, regional dan global dalam mengelola masalah kesehatan individu, keluarga, komunitas dan Masyarakat.
cpl.isi_en: 1. Able to practise medicine professionally in accordance with the values and principles of faith in God, high morals, ethics, discipline, law, socio-cultural values and religion in local, regional and global contexts when managing the health problems of individuals, families, communities and society.

cpl.isi: 2. Mampu melakukan praktik kedokteran dengan melakukan refleksi diri, menyadari keterbatasan, mengatasi masalah personal, dan meningkatkan pengetahuan secara berkesinambungan, serta menghasilkan karya inovatif dalam rangka menyelesaikan masalah kesehatan individu, keluarga, komunitas dan masyarakat demi keselamatan pasien dengan berkolaborasi dan bekerja sama dengan sejawat seprofesi, interprofesi kesehatan dan profesi lain dalam engelolaan masalah kesehatan dengan menerapkan nilai, etika, peran dan tanggung jawab, pengelolaan masalah secara efektif
cpl.isi_en: 2. Able to practise medicine through self-reflection, awareness of one's limitations, dealing with personal problems and continuously improving knowledge, and to produce innovative work to solve the health problems of individuals, families, communities and society for the sake of patient safety, collaborating and cooperating with peers in the same profession, other health professions and other professions in managing health problems by applying values, ethics, roles and responsibilities, and managing problems effectively.

cpl.isi: 3. Mampu memanfaatkan pengetahuan ilmiah dalam rangka melakukan perubahan terhadap fenomena kedokteran dan kesehatan melalui tindakan kedokteran dan intervensi kesehatan pada individu, keluarga, komunitas dan masyarakat untuk kesejahteraan dan keselamatan manusia, serta kemajuan ilmu dalam bidang kedokteran dan kesehatan yang memperhatikan kajian inter/multidisiplin, inovatif dan teruji.
cpl.isi_en: 3. Able to use scientific knowledge to bring about changes in medical and health phenomena through medical actions and health interventions for individuals, families, communities and society, for human welfare and safety and for the advancement of medical and health sciences, taking into account interdisciplinary or multidisciplinary, innovative and tested studies.

cpl.isi: 4. Mampu untuk menemukan, mengevaluasi, menggunakan, mendiseminasikan dan menghasilkan inovasi bidang kesehatan dengan menggunakan teknologi informasi dan komunikasi secara efektif untuk pengembangan profesi, keilmuan serta dan peningkatan mutu pelayanan kesehatan.
cpl.isi_en: 4. Able to find, evaluate, use, disseminate and produce innovations in health by using information and communication technology effectively for the development of the profession and the discipline and for improving the quality of health services.

cpl.isi: 5. Mampu mengelola masalah kesehatan individu, keluarga, komunitas dan Masyarakat secara komprehensif, holistik, terpadu dan berkesinambungan menggunakan sumber daya secara efektif dalam konteks pelayanan kesehatan primer serta menjadi agen perubahan dalam pencapaian derajat kesehatan yang maksimal
cpl.isi_en: 5. Able to manage the health problems of individuals, families, communities and society in a comprehensive, holistic, integrated and continuous manner, using resources effectively in the context of primary health care, and to act as an agent of change in achieving the highest possible level of health.

cpl.isi: Mampu melakukan prosedur klinis yang berkaitan dengan masalah kesehatan dengan menerapkan prinsip keselamatan pasien, keselamatan diri sendiri, dan keselamatan orang lain.
cpl.isi_en: Able to perform clinical procedures related to health problems by applying the principles of patient safety, self-safety and the safety of others.

cpl.isi: Mampu membangun hubungan, menggali informasi, menerima dan bertukar informasi, bernegosiasi serta persuasi secara verbal dan non-verbal; menunjukkan empati kepada pasien, anggota keluarga, masyarakat dan sejawat, dalam tatanan keragaman budaya lokal dan regional.
cpl.isi_en: Able to build relationships, gather information, receive and exchange information, negotiate and persuade verbally and non-verbally, and to show empathy towards patients, family members, the community and colleagues in the setting of local and regional cultural diversity.

cpl.isi: 8. Mampu mengelola masalah kesehatan individu, keluarga, komunitas dan masyarakat secara komprehensif, holistik, terpadu dan berkesinambungan menggunakan sumber daya secara efektif dalam konteks kedokteran parawisata, management bencana, kesehatan olahraga, kedokteran herbal melalui pencegahan, penanganan dan/atau rehabilitasi berwawasan pasifik dan enterprenership
cpl.isi_en: 8. Able to manage the health problems of individuals, families, communities and society in a comprehensive, holistic, integrated and continuous manner, using resources effectively in the context of tourism medicine, disaster management, sports medicine and herbal medicine, through prevention, treatment and/or rehabilitation with a Pacific perspective and an entrepreneurial mindset.

program.bidang_kerja: Pelayanan dokter spesialis mata di rumah sakit atau klinik mata; diagnosis dan tata laksana penyakit mata; tindakan sesuai kompetensi; penelitian serta pendidikan klinis, dengan pemenuhan izin praktik.
program.bidang_kerja_en: Ophthalmologist services in hospitals or eye clinics; diagnosis and management of eye diseases; procedures within professional competence; clinical research and education, with a licence to practise.

cpl.isi: Menunjukkan integritas pribadi dan profesional yang dilandasi nilai religius, nasionalisme, dan humanisme, serta menjunjung tinggi etika, nilai akademik, dan filosofi kemanusiaan dalam penguasaan dan penerapan Ilmu Kesehatan Mata secara mandiri, profesional, dan bertanggung jawab.
cpl.isi_en: Shows personal and professional integrity grounded in religious values, nationalism and humanism, and upholds ethics, academic values and a humane philosophy in mastering and applying ophthalmology independently, professionally and responsibly.

cpl.isi:
SPM-P1
Mampu mendiagnosis, mengelola, dan merujuk kasus kesehatan mata secara profesional, serta melaksanakan promosi kesehatan mata berbasis komunitas dengan dukungan keterampilan akademik dan komunikasi ilmiah. Mampu menerapkan Ilmu Kesehatan Mata secara komprehensif dan berbasis teknologi mutakhir melalui pendekatan interdisipliner, berbasis bukti dan berbasis nilai, yang berlandaskan nilai kebangsaan, keagamaan, dan pemberdayaan masyarakat
cpl.isi_en:
SPM-P1
Able to diagnose, manage and refer eye health cases professionally and to carry out community-based eye health promotion, supported by academic and scientific communication skills. Able to apply ophthalmology comprehensively and on the basis of the latest technology through an interdisciplinary, evidence-based and value-based approach, grounded in national and religious values and community empowerment.

cpl.isi:
SPM-P2
Mampu menerapkan ilmu Kesehatan Mata secara profesional, komprehensif, dan berbasis teknologi mutakhir, dengan penguasaan multidisipliner di berbagai modul subspesialisasi—meliputi Refraksi, Lensa Kontak dan Low Vision; Infeksi dan Imunologi; Katarak dan Bedah Refraktif; Pediatrik Oftalmologi dan Strabismus; Glaukoma; Vitreo-Retina; Rekonstruksi, Okuloplasti dan Onkologi; Neuro-Oftalmologi; serta Oftalmologi Komunitas—didukung keterampilan klinis, akademik, kepemimpinan, komunikasi dwibahasa, serta nilai keagamaan, kebangsaan, geopolitik, kewirausahaan, dan pemberdayaan masyarakat di era revolusi industri 4.0.
cpl.isi_en:
SPM-P2
Able to apply ophthalmology professionally, comprehensively and on the basis of the latest technology, with multidisciplinary mastery of the subspecialty modules — refraction, contact lenses and low vision; infection and immunology; cataract and refractive surgery; paediatric ophthalmology and strabismus; glaucoma; vitreoretina; reconstruction, oculoplastics and oncology; neuro-ophthalmology; and community ophthalmology — supported by clinical, academic, leadership and bilingual communication skills and by religious, national, geopolitical, entrepreneurial and community empowerment values in the era of the fourth industrial revolution.

cpl.isi:
SPM-P3
Menguasai secara menyeluruh prinsip, konsep, dan pengetahuan biomedis, klinis, perilaku, komunikasi, serta kesehatan masyarakat yang menjadi landasan praktik Ilmu Kesehatan Mata, berlandaskan nilai keagamaan dan kebangsaan.
Mampu memanfaatkan pengetahuan tersebut untuk melaksanakan prosedur klinis sesuai kewenangan, menangani permasalahan kesehatan mata pada individu maupun masyarakat melalui pendekatan interdisipliner, mengelola informasi dan sumber daya secara optimal, serta berperan aktif dalam pendidikan, promosi kesehatan mata, dan pengembangan profesi kedokteran di tingkat layanan primer dan sekunder.
cpl.isi_en:
SPM-P3
Masters thoroughly the principles, concepts and knowledge of the biomedical, clinical, behavioural, communication and public health sciences that underlie the practice of ophthalmology, grounded in religious and national values.
Able to use this knowledge to carry out clinical procedures within one's authority, to address the eye health problems of individuals and the community through an interdisciplinary approach, to manage information and resources optimally, and to play an active role in education, eye health promotion and the development of the medical profession at the primary and secondary care levels.

cpl.isi:
SPM-KU1
Mampu menjalankan profesi Dokter Spesialis Kesehatan Mata secara etis, kolaboratif, dan berstandar internasional, dengan kepemimpinan, evaluasi kritis, komunikasi akademik dwibahasa, serta semangat kebangsaan dan toleransi dalam membangun kehidupan masyarakat yang berkeadaban
cpl.isi_en:
SPM-KU1
Able to practise as an ophthalmologist ethically, collaboratively and to international standards, with leadership, critical evaluation, bilingual academic communication, and a spirit of nationhood and tolerance in building a civilised society.

cpl.isi:
SPM-KU2
Mampu menjalankan profesi Dokter Spesialis Kesehatan Mata secara mandiri dan bertanggung jawab, dengan kompetensi klinis dan akademik setara standar nasional dan internasional, didukung kemampuan berpikir kritis, komunikasi ilmiah dwibahasa, kolaborasi lintas profesi, pengembangan kebijakan dan organisasi, serta penerapan nilai-nilai keagamaan, kebangsaan, geopolitik, dan kewirausahaan berbasis potensi lokal dan global.
cpl.isi_en:
SPM-KU2
Able to practise as an ophthalmologist independently and responsibly, with clinical and academic competence equivalent to national and international standards, supported by critical thinking, bilingual scientific communication, interprofessional collaboration, policy and organisational development, and the application of religious, national, geopolitical and entrepreneurial values based on local and global potential.

cpl.isi:
SPM-KU3
Mampu menjalankan praktik sebagai Dokter Spesialis Kesehatan Mata secara mandiri dan bertanggung jawab sesuai standar nasional dan internasional.
Mampu mengambil keputusan klinis dan strategis secara logis, kritis, dan etis; memimpin serta berkolaborasi lintas profesi dalam menyelesaikan masalah kompleks, mengembangkan inovasi, komunikasi ilmiah, jejaring kerja, dan berkontribusi pada kebijakan, pendidikan, serta penguatan organisasi dengan menjunjung nilai humaniora, keagamaan, kebangsaan, dan etika profesi.
cpl.isi_en:
SPM-KU3
Able to practise as an ophthalmologist independently and responsibly in accordance with national and international standards.
Able to make clinical and strategic decisions logically, critically and ethically; to lead and collaborate across professions in solving complex problems; to develop innovation, scientific communication and networks; and to contribute to policy, education and organisational strengthening, upholding humanities, religious and national values and professional ethics.

cpl.isi:
SPM-KK1
Mampu menegakkan diagnosis dan merencanakan tata laksana kasus kesehatan mata secara komprehensif, termasuk konsultasi ke subspesialis mata dan penanganan kasus yang berkaitan dengan bidang medis lain, dengan mempertimbangkan faktor pasien, keluarga, dan lingkungan.
cpl.isi_en:
SPM-KK1
Able to establish a diagnosis and plan the management of eye health cases comprehensively, including consultation with ophthalmic subspecialists and the management of cases related to other medical fields, taking into account patient, family and environmental factors.

cpl.isi:
SPM-KK2
Mampu menegakkan diagnosis, merencanakan, dan melaksanakan tata laksana kasus kesehatan mata secara profesional, mandiri, dan terintegrasi di berbagai modul subspesialisasi—termasuk Refraksi, Lensa Kontak dan Low Vision; Infeksi dan Imunologi; Katarak dan Bedah Refraktif; Pediatrik Oftalmologi dan Strabismus; Glaukoma; Vitreo-Retina; Rekonstruksi, Okuloplasti dan Onkologi; Neuro-Oftalmologi; serta Oftalmologi Komunitas—dengan dukungan pemeriksaan penunjang, pendekatan multidisipliner, serta mempertimbangkan aspek klinis, psikososial, dan epidemiologis pasien.
cpl.isi_en:
SPM-KK2
Able to establish a diagnosis and to plan and carry out the management of eye health cases professionally, independently and in an integrated way across the subspecialty modules — including refraction, contact lenses and low vision; infection and immunology; cataract and refractive surgery; paediatric ophthalmology and strabismus; glaucoma; vitreoretina; reconstruction, oculoplastics and oncology; neuro-ophthalmology; and community ophthalmology — supported by investigations and a multidisciplinary approach, and taking into account the clinical, psychosocial and epidemiological aspects of the patient.

SPM-KK3
Able to carry out independently all the clinical skills of ophthalmology, including history-taking, physical examination, interpretation of investigations, diagnosis, the planning and delivery of comprehensive management, the management of ophthalmic emergencies, and consultation with subspecialists.
Able to manage complex medical problems in an integrated way, taking into account the patient, the family and the community.

program.bidang_kerja: Pelayanan dokter spesialis penyakit dalam; penanganan penyakit organ dalam pada pasien dewasa; pengelolaan layanan rawat jalan dan rawat inap; penelitian serta pendidikan klinis, sesuai kompetensi dan izin praktik.
program.bidang_kerja_en: Internal medicine specialist services; management of internal organ diseases in adult patients; management of outpatient and inpatient services; clinical research and education, within professional competence and a licence to practise.

cpl.isi: Menunjukkan integritas pribadi dan profesional yang religius, humanis, nasionalis, dan etis dalam menjalankan tugas sebagai warga negara dan dokter spesialis, dengan menjunjung tinggi nilai Pancasila, hukum, norma akademik, serta etika profesi; memiliki kepekaan sosial, semangat kemandirian, dan komitmen untuk memanusiakan sesama sesuai filosofi Si tou timou tumou tou; serta mampu berkontribusi secara aktif dalam peningkatan mutu kehidupan masyarakat dan kemajuan peradaban.
cpl.isi_en: Shows religious, humanist, nationalist and ethical personal and professional integrity in carrying out duties as a citizen and a medical specialist, upholding the values of Pancasila, the law, academic norms and professional ethics; has social sensitivity, a spirit of independence and a commitment to helping others to be human in line with the philosophy of Si Tou Timou Tumou Tou; and is able to contribute actively to improving the quality of life in society and to the progress of civilisation.

cpl.isi: Mampu mendiagnosis, mengelola, dan merujuk kasus penyakit dalam secara profesional, serta melaksanakan promosi kesehatan berbasis komunitas dengan dukungan keterampilan akademik dan komunikasi ilmiah. Mampu menerapkan ilmu Penyakit Dalam secara komprehensif dan berbasis teknologi mutakhir, melalui pendekatan interdisipliner, evidence-based dan value-based, yang berlandaskan nilai kebangsaan, keagamaan, dan pemberdayaan masyarakat.
cpl.isi_en: Able to diagnose, manage and refer internal medicine cases professionally and to carry out community-based health promotion, supported by academic and scientific communication skills. Able to apply internal medicine comprehensively and on the basis of the latest technology, through an interdisciplinary, evidence-based and value-based approach grounded in national and religious values and community empowerment.

cpl.isi: Mampu menjalankan profesi Dokter Spesialis Penyakit Dalam secara etis, kolaboratif, dan berstandar internasional, dengan kepemimpinan, evaluasi kritis, komunikasi akademik dwibahasa, serta semangat kebangsaan dan toleransi dalam membangun kehidupan masyarakat yang berkeadaban.
cpl.isi_en: Able to practise as an internal medicine specialist ethically, collaboratively and to international standards, with leadership, critical evaluation, bilingual academic communication, and a spirit of nationhood and tolerance in building a civilised society.

cpl.isi: Mampu menegakkan diagnosis dan merencanakan tata laksana penyakit dalam secara komprehensif, termasuk konsultasi ke subspesialis dan penanganan kasus yang terkait bidang medis lain, dengan mempertimbangkan faktor pasien, keluarga, dan lingkungan.
cpl.isi_en: Able to establish a diagnosis and plan the management of internal medicine cases comprehensively, including consultation with subspecialists and the management of cases related to other medical fields, taking into account patient, family and environmental factors.

cpl.isi: Mampu menerapkan ilmu Penyakit Dalam secara profesional, komprehensif, dan berbasis teknologi mutakhir, dengan penguasaan multidisipliner di seluruh 12 bidang subspesialisasi—meliputi gastroenterologi-hepatologi, endokrin,  nefrologi, hematologi-onkologi, kardiologi, pulmonologi, reumatologi, infeksi tropik, geriatri, alergi-imunologi, psikosomatik, dan kedokteran hiperbarik, serta bidang umum—didukung keterampilan klinis, akademik, kepemimpinan, komunikasi dwibahasa, serta nilai keagamaan, kebangsaan, geopolitik, kewirausahaan, dan pengembangan masyarakat di era revolusi industri 4.0.
cpl.isi_en: Able to apply internal medicine professionally, comprehensively and on the basis of the latest technology, with multidisciplinary mastery of all 12 subspecialty areas — gastroenterology and hepatology, endocrinology, nephrology, haematology and oncology, cardiology, pulmonology, rheumatology, tropical infection, geriatrics, allergy and immunology, psychosomatic medicine and hyperbaric medicine — and general internal medicine, supported by clinical, academic, leadership and bilingual communication skills and by religious, national, geopolitical, entrepreneurial and community development values in the era of the fourth industrial revolution.

cpl.isi: Mampu menjalankan profesi Dokter Spesialis Penyakit Dalam secara mandiri dan bertanggung jawab, dengan kompetensi klinis dan akademik yang setara standar nasional dan internasional, didukung kemampuan berpikir kritis, komunikasi ilmiah dwibahasa, kolaborasi lintas profesi, pengembangan kebijakan dan organisasi, serta penerapan nilai-nilai keagamaan, kebangsaan, geopolitik, dan kewirausahaan berbasis potensi lokal dan global.
cpl.isi_en: Able to practise as an internal medicine specialist independently and responsibly, with clinical and academic competence equivalent to national and international standards, supported by critical thinking, bilingual scientific communication, interprofessional collaboration, policy and organisational development, and the application of religious, national, geopolitical and entrepreneurial values based on local and global potential.

cpl.isi: Mampu menegakkan diagnosis, merencanakan, dan melaksanakan tata laksana penyakit dalam secara profesional, mandiri, dan terintegrasi di berbagai bidang subspesialisasi—termasuk gastroenterologi-hepatologi, endokrin,  nefrologi, hematologi-onkologi, kardiologi, pulmonologi, reumatologi, infeksi tropik, geriatri, alergi-imunologi, psikosomatik, dan kedokteran hiperbarik—dengan dukungan pemeriksaan penunjang, pendekatan multidisipliner, serta pertimbangan aspek klinis, psikososial, dan epidemiologis pasien.
cpl.isi_en: Able to establish a diagnosis and to plan and carry out the management of internal medicine cases professionally, independently and in an integrated way across the subspecialty areas — including gastroenterology and hepatology, endocrinology, nephrology, haematology and oncology, cardiology, pulmonology, rheumatology, tropical infection, geriatrics, allergy and immunology, psychosomatic medicine and hyperbaric medicine — supported by investigations and a multidisciplinary approach, and taking into account the clinical, psychosocial and epidemiological aspects of the patient.

cpl.isi: Menguasai secara komprehensif prinsip, konsep, dan pengetahuan biomedik, klinik, perilaku, komunikasi, kesehatan masyarakat, serta nilai-nilai keagamaan dan kebangsaan yang mendasari praktik Ilmu Penyakit Dalam; mampu menerapkan pengetahuan tersebut untuk melakukan prosedur klinis sesuai kewenangan, menangani masalah kesehatan individu dan masyarakat secara interdisipliner, mengelola informasi dan sumber daya secara efektif, serta berkontribusi dalam pendidikan, promosi kesehatan, dan pengembangan profesi kedokteran di tingkat primer dan sekunder.
cpl.isi_en: Masters comprehensively the principles, concepts and knowledge of the biomedical, clinical, behavioural, communication and public health sciences, together with the religious and national values, that underlie the practice of internal medicine; able to apply this knowledge to carry out clinical procedures within one's authority, to address individual and community health problems in an interdisciplinary way, to manage information and resources effectively, and to contribute to education, health promotion and the development of the medical profession at the primary and secondary care levels.

cpl.isi: Mampu menjalankan praktik profesional sebagai Dokter Spesialis Penyakit Dalam secara mandiri dan bertanggung jawab, dengan kompetensi kerja yang sesuai standar nasional dan internasional; mampu mengambil keputusan klinis dan strategis secara logis, kritis, dan etis; memimpin dan berkolaborasi lintas profesi dalam menyelesaikan masalah kompleks; mengembangkan inovasi, komunikasi ilmiah, dan jejaring kerja; serta berkontribusi dalam pengembangan kebijakan, pendidikan, dan kapasitas organisasi dengan menjunjung tinggi nilai humaniora, keagamaan, kebangsaan, dan etika profesi.
cpl.isi_en: Able to practise professionally as an internal medicine specialist independently and responsibly, with work competence meeting national and international standards; able to make clinical and strategic decisions logically, critically and ethically; to lead and collaborate across professions in solving complex problems; to develop innovation, scientific communication and networks; and to contribute to the development of policy, education and organisational capacity, upholding humanities, religious and national values and professional ethics.

cpl.isi: Mampu melaksanakan secara mandiri dan profesional seluruh rangkaian keterampilan klinis dalam bidang Ilmu Penyakit Dalam, termasuk anamnesis, pemeriksaan fisik, penetapan dan interpretasi pemeriksaan penunjang, penegakan diagnosis dan diagnosis banding, perencanaan tata laksana yang komprehensif dan kontekstual, penatalaksanaan kasus gawat darurat, serta konsultasi ke subspesialis; mampu menangani permasalahan medis yang kompleks dan lintas bidang secara terintegrasi, dengan mempertimbangkan aspek pasien, keluarga, dan masyarakat.
cpl.isi_en: Able to carry out independently and professionally the full range of clinical skills in internal medicine, including history-taking, physical examination, the selection and interpretation of investigations, diagnosis and differential diagnosis, comprehensive and contextual management planning, the management of emergencies, and consultation with subspecialists; able to deal with complex, cross-disciplinary medical problems in an integrated way, taking into account the patient, the family and the community.

cpl.isi_en: Able to establish a diagnosis and plan the management of internal medicine cases comprehensively, including consultation with subspecialists and the management of cases related to other medical fields, taking into account patient, family and environmental factors.

cpl.isi: Mampu menerapkan ilmu Penyakit Dalam secara profesional, komprehensif, dan berbasis teknologi mutakhir, dengan penguasaan multidisipliner di seluruh 12 bidang subspesialisasi—meliputi gastroenterologi-hepatologi, endokrin, nefrologi, hematologi-onkologi, kardiologi, pulmonologi, reumatologi, infeksi tropik, geriatri, alergi-imunologi, psikosomatik, dan kedokteran hiperbarik, serta bidang umum—didukung keterampilan klinis, akademik, kepemimpinan, komunikasi dwibahasa, serta nilai keagamaan, kebangsaan, geopolitik, kewirausahaan, dan pengembangan masyarakat di era revolusi industri 4.0.
cpl.isi_en: Able to apply internal medicine professionally, comprehensively and on the basis of the latest technology, with multidisciplinary mastery of all 12 subspecialty areas — gastroenterology and hepatology, endocrinology, nephrology, haematology and oncology, cardiology, pulmonology, rheumatology, tropical infection, geriatrics, allergy and immunology, psychosomatic medicine and hyperbaric medicine — and general internal medicine, supported by clinical, academic, leadership and bilingual communication skills and by religious, national, geopolitical, entrepreneurial and community development values in the era of the fourth industrial revolution.

cpl.isi: Mampu menjalankan profesi Dokter Spesialis Penyakit Dalam secara mandiri dan bertanggung jawab, dengan kompetensi klinis dan akademik yang setara standar nasional dan internasional, didukung kemampuan berpikir kritis, komunikasi ilmiah dwibahasa, kolaborasi lintas profesi, pengembangan kebijakan dan organisasi, serta penerapan nilai-nilai keagamaan, kebangsaan, geopolitik, dan kewirausahaan berbasis potensi lokal dan global.
cpl.isi_en: Able to practise as an internal medicine specialist independently and responsibly, with clinical and academic competence equivalent to national and international standards, supported by critical thinking, bilingual scientific communication, interprofessional collaboration, policy and organisational development, and the application of religious, national, geopolitical and entrepreneurial values based on local and global potential.

cpl.isi: Mampu menegakkan diagnosis, merencanakan, dan melaksanakan tata laksana penyakit dalam secara profesional, mandiri, dan terintegrasi di berbagai bidang subspesialisasi—termasuk gastroenterologi-hepatologi, endokrin, nefrologi, hematologi-onkologi, kardiologi, pulmonologi, reumatologi, infeksi tropik, geriatri, alergi-imunologi, psikosomatik, dan kedokteran hiperbarik—dengan dukungan pemeriksaan penunjang, pendekatan multidisipliner, serta pertimbangan aspek klinis, psikososial, dan epidemiologis pasien.
cpl.isi_en: Able to establish a diagnosis and to plan and carry out the management of internal medicine cases professionally, independently and in an integrated way across the subspecialty areas — including gastroenterology and hepatology, endocrinology, nephrology, haematology and oncology, cardiology, pulmonology, rheumatology, tropical infection, geriatrics, allergy and immunology, psychosomatic medicine and hyperbaric medicine — supported by investigations and a multidisciplinary approach, and taking into account the clinical, psychosocial and epidemiological aspects of the patient.

cpl.isi: Menguasai secara komprehensif prinsip, konsep, dan pengetahuan biomedik, klinik, perilaku, komunikasi, kesehatan masyarakat, serta nilai-nilai keagamaan dan kebangsaan yang mendasari praktik Ilmu Penyakit Dalam; mampu menerapkan pengetahuan tersebut untuk melakukan prosedur klinis sesuai kewenangan, menangani masalah kesehatan individu dan masyarakat secara interdisipliner, mengelola informasi dan sumber daya secara efektif, serta berkontribusi dalam pendidikan, promosi kesehatan, dan pengembangan profesi kedokteran di tingkat primer dan sekunder.
cpl.isi_en: Masters comprehensively the principles, concepts and knowledge of the biomedical, clinical, behavioural, communication and public health sciences, together with the religious and national values, that underlie the practice of internal medicine; able to apply this knowledge to carry out clinical procedures within one's authority, to address individual and community health problems in an interdisciplinary way, to manage information and resources effectively, and to contribute to education, health promotion and the development of the medical profession at the primary and secondary care levels.

cpl.isi: Mampu menjalankan praktik profesional sebagai Dokter Spesialis Penyakit Dalam secara mandiri dan bertanggung jawab, dengan kompetensi kerja yang sesuai standar nasional dan internasional; mampu mengambil keputusan klinis dan strategis secara logis, kritis, dan etis; memimpin dan berkolaborasi lintas profesi dalam menyelesaikan masalah kompleks; mengembangkan inovasi, komunikasi ilmiah, dan jejaring kerja; serta berkontribusi dalam pengembangan kebijakan, pendidikan, dan kapasitas organisasi dengan menjunjung tinggi nilai humaniora, keagamaan, kebangsaan, dan etika profesi.
cpl.isi_en: Able to practise professionally as an internal medicine specialist independently and responsibly, with work competence meeting national and international standards; able to make clinical and strategic decisions logically, critically and ethically; to lead and collaborate across professions in solving complex problems; to develop innovation, scientific communication and networks; and to contribute to the development of policy, education and organisational capacity, upholding humanities, religious and national values and professional ethics.

cpl.isi: Mampu melaksanakan secara mandiri dan profesional seluruh rangkaian keterampilan klinis dalam bidang Ilmu Penyakit Dalam, termasuk anamnesis, pemeriksaan fisik, penetapan dan interpretasi pemeriksaan penunjang, penegakan diagnosis dan diagnosis banding, perencanaan tata laksana yang komprehensif dan kontekstual, penatalaksanaan kasus gawat darurat, serta konsultasi ke subspesialis; mampu menangani permasalahan medis yang kompleks dan lintas bidang secara terintegrasi, dengan mempertimbangkan aspek pasien, keluarga, dan masyarakat.
cpl.isi_en: Able to carry out independently and professionally the full range of clinical skills in internal medicine, including history-taking, physical examination, the selection and interpretation of investigations, diagnosis and differential diagnosis, comprehensive and contextual management planning, the management of emergencies, and consultation with subspecialists; able to deal with complex, cross-disciplinary medical problems in an integrated way, taking into account the patient, the family and the community.

program.bidang_kerja: Pelayanan dokter spesialis neurologi di rumah sakit atau klinik; tata laksana penyakit sistem saraf; pengelolaan layanan neurologi; penelitian dan pendidikan klinis, sesuai kompetensi serta izin praktik.
program.bidang_kerja_en: Neurologist services in hospitals or clinics; management of nervous system diseases; management of neurology services; clinical research and education, within professional competence and a licence to practise.

cpl.isi: Berkontribusi dalam peningkatan mutu kehidupan bermasyarakat, berbangsa, bernegara dan kemajuan peradaban berdasarkan Pancasila
cpl.isi_en: Contributes to improving the quality of life in society, the nation and the state and to the progress of civilisation based on Pancasila.

cpl.isi: Mampu mengejawantahkan filosofi Si Tou Timou Tumou Tou yang artinya manusia baru dapat disebut sebagai manusia, jika sudah dapat memanusiakan manusia lain dalam kehidupan sehari-hari
cpl.isi_en: Able to put into practice in daily life the philosophy of Si Tou Timou Tumou Tou, which means that a person can only be called truly human when they help others to be human.

cpl.isi: Mampu mengaplikasikan bidang Neurologi secara profesional dengan menjunjung tinggi etika profesi
cpl.isi_en: Able to practise neurology professionally, upholding professional ethics.

cpl.isi: MenErapkan mawas diri, belajar sepanjang hayat, mengembangkan pengetahuan sehingga mam[pu mengimplementasikan ilmu-ilmu kedokteran terkini yang berbasis bukti di era revolusi industri 4.0
cpl.isi_en: Practises self-awareness and lifelong learning and develops knowledge so as to be able to implement the latest evidence-based medical science in the era of the fourth industrial revolution.

cpl.isi: Mampu menceramti dan memanfaatkan perkembangan ilmu penegetahuan dan teknologi terkini dalam meningkatkan keterampilan klinis praktis dalam bidang kedokteran
cpl.isi_en: Able to observe carefully and use the latest developments in science and technology to improve practical clinical skills in medicine.

cpl.isi: Mengetahui, memiliki, memahami teori, konsep umum dan dasar prinsip - prinsip pada semua penyakit yang relevansi dibidang Neurologi  terkini sesuai Standar Kolegium Neurologi Indonesia
cpl.isi_en: Knows, has and understands the theories, general concepts and basic principles of all diseases relevant to current neurology in accordance with the standards of the Indonesian College of Neurology.

cpl.isi: Menguasai dan mampu menerapkan konsep dasar dan asas - asas rasa kebangsaan dan cinta tanah air, menggunakan bahasa Indonesia yang baik terutama dalam bidang akademik
cpl.isi_en: Masters and is able to apply the basic concepts and principles of nationhood and love for the homeland, and uses good Indonesian, especially in academic settings.

program.bidang_kerja: Pelayanan dokter spesialis kulit dan kelamin; diagnosis serta tata laksana penyakit kulit dan infeksi menular seksual; penelitian dan pendidikan klinis, sesuai kompetensi serta izin praktik.
program.bidang_kerja_en: Dermatology and venereology specialist services; diagnosis and management of skin diseases and sexually transmitted infections; clinical research and education, within professional competence and a licence to practise.

cpl.isi: Mampu menguasai pengetahuan dasar umum dan khusus dalam bidang dermatologi dan venereologi serta pemeriksaan penunjang
cpl.isi_en: Able to master general and specific basic knowledge in dermatology and venereology and related investigations.

cpl.isi: Mampu menguasai pengetahuan dermatologi secara umum, menerapkan cara pengumpulan data, pemeriksaan fisik dan pemeriksaan penunjang
cpl.isi_en: Able to master general dermatological knowledge and to apply methods of data collection, physical examination and investigations.

cpl.isi: Mampu menguasai penyakit infeksi bakteri dan virus serta mampu menginterpretasi hasil laboratorium sederhana
cpl.isi_en: Able to master bacterial and viral infectious diseases and to interpret simple laboratory results.

cpl.isi: Mampu menguasai penyakit infeksi jamur, infestasi parasit dan cacing serta mampu menginterpretasi hasil laboratorium sederhana
cpl.isi_en: Able to master fungal infections and parasitic and helminth infestations and to interpret simple laboratory results.

cpl.isi: Mampu menguasai etiopatogenesis, gejala dan tanda klinis, klasifikasi, perjalanan penyakit, diagnosis kerja dan diagnosis banding, uji diagnostik, pengelolaan pasien, serta prognosis berbagai penyakit di bidang dermatologi geriatri
cpl.isi_en: Able to master the aetiopathogenesis, clinical symptoms and signs, classification, course, working and differential diagnosis, diagnostic tests, patient management and prognosis of various diseases in geriatric dermatology.

cpl.isi: Mampu menguasai etiopatogenesis, gejala dan tanda klinis, klasifikasi, perjalanan penyakit, diagnosis kerja dan diagnosis banding, uji diagnostik, pengelolaan pasien, serta prognosis berbagai penyakit di bidang dermatologi anak
cpl.isi_en: Able to master the aetiopathogenesis, clinical symptoms and signs, classification, course, working and differential diagnosis, diagnostic tests, patient management and prognosis of various diseases in paediatric dermatology.

cpl.isi: Mampu menguasai kelainan kulit pada alergo-imunologi, dapat melakukan uji kulit dan interpretasi hasil uji kulit
cpl.isi_en: Able to master skin disorders in allergy and immunology, and to perform skin tests and interpret their results.

cpl.isi: Mampu menguasai penyakit venereologi dan mampu menginterpretasi hasil laboratorium sederhana
cpl.isi_en: Able to master venereal diseases and to interpret simple laboratory results.

cpl.isi: Mampu menguasai etiopatogenesis, gejala dan tanda klinis, klasifikasi, perjalanan penyakit, diagnosis kerja dan diagnosis banding, uji diagnostik, pengelolaan pasien, serta prognosis berbagai penyakit di bidang dermatologi kosmetik
cpl.isi_en: Able to master the aetiopathogenesis, clinical symptoms and signs, classification, course, working and differential diagnosis, diagnostic tests, patient management and prognosis of various diseases in cosmetic dermatology.

cpl.isi: Mampu menguasai etiopatogenesis, gejala dan tanda klinis, klasifikasi, perjalanan penyakit, diagnosis kerja dan diagnosis banding, uji diagnostik, pengelolaan pasien, serta prognosis berbagai penyakit di bidang dermatologi tumor dan bedah kulit.
cpl.isi_en: Able to master the aetiopathogenesis, clinical symptoms and signs, classification, course, working and differential diagnosis, diagnostic tests, patient management and prognosis of various diseases in dermatological oncology and dermatological surgery.

cpl.isi: Mampu menguasai ilmu penyakit dermatovenereologi dan mampu melakukan praktek bidang dermatovenereologi secara mandiri serta menguasai metodologi penelitian, statistika sehingga mampu menyusun dan menyajikan proposal penelitian tesis
cpl.isi_en: Able to master dermatovenereology and to practise independently in dermatovenereology, and to master research methodology and statistics so as to prepare and present a thesis research proposal.

cpl.isi:
Mampu menguasai ilmu penyakit dermatovenereologi dan mampu melakukan praktik bidang dermatovenereologi secara mandiri serta mampu menyusun, menyajikan dan
menguasai laporan kasus
cpl.isi_en: Able to master dermatovenereology and to practise independently in dermatovenereology, and to prepare, present and master case reports.

cpl.isi: Mampu menyusun, menyajikan dan menguasai tinjauan pustaka serta ujian kasus lokal
cpl.isi_en: Able to prepare, present and master literature reviews and local case examinations.

cpl.isi: menguasai ilmu penyakit dermatovenereologi dan metodologi penelitian serta statistika sehingga mampu menyusun dan menyajikan tesis
cpl.isi_en: Masters dermatovenereology, research methodology and statistics so as to prepare and present a thesis.

cpl.isi: Mampu Menguasai Metodologi Penelitian dan Statiska dalam bidang kedokteran
cpl.isi_en: Able to master research methodology and statistics in medicine.

program.bidang_kerja: Pelayanan dokter spesialis anestesiologi dan terapi intensif; anestesi perioperatif; perawatan intensif; penanganan nyeri serta resusitasi; penelitian dan pendidikan klinis, sesuai kompetensi serta izin praktik.
program.bidang_kerja_en: Anaesthesiology and intensive care specialist services; perioperative anaesthesia; intensive care; pain management and resuscitation; clinical research and education, within professional competence and a licence to practise.

program.bidang_kerja: Pelayanan dokter spesialis bedah di rumah sakit; tindakan bedah elektif dan kegawatdaruratan; perawatan perioperatif; penelitian serta pendidikan klinis bedah, sesuai kompetensi dan izin praktik.
program.bidang_kerja_en: Surgeon services in hospitals; elective and emergency surgical procedures; perioperative care; clinical research and surgical education, within professional competence and a licence to practise.

cpl.isi: Mampu menginternalisasi nilai, norma dan etika akademik serta dapat mengaplikasikan bidang Ilmu Bedah secara profesional dengan menjunjung tinggi etika profesi.
cpl.isi_en: Able to internalise academic values, norms and ethics and to apply surgery professionally, upholding professional ethics.

cpl.isi: Mampu menjelaskan tentang anatomi dan fisiologi, farmakologi, mikrobiologi dan radiotomi yang relevan dan berhubungan dengan ilmu bedah pada tahap pra bedah dasar berikut permasalahannya
cpl.isi_en: Able to explain the anatomy and physiology, pharmacology, microbiology and radioanatomy relevant to surgery at the basic pre-surgical stage, and the related problems.

cpl.isi: Mampu menjelaskan teori kedokteran klinik umum yang menjadi prinsip dasar dan relevan di dalam penatalaksanaan pasien bedah baik tahap perioperative maupun intra operatif
cpl.isi_en: Able to explain the theories of general clinical medicine that are basic principles relevant to the management of surgical patients in both the perioperative and intraoperative stages.

cpl.isi: Menjelaskan konsep filsafat ilmu, metodologi penelitian kedokteran, biostatistika, etika penelitian, bioetik serta menerapkannya di dalam bentuk penelitian mandiri pada ilmu dasar umum dan humaniora
cpl.isi_en: Explains the concepts of the philosophy of science, medical research methodology, biostatistics, research ethics and bioethics, and applies them in independent research in the general basic sciences and the humanities.

cpl.isi: Mampu melakukan telaah kritis hasil – hasil penelitian kedokteran, menjelaskan profesionalisme bedah, prinsip-prinsip dasar keselamatan pasien dokter dan personal kesehatan.
cpl.isi_en: Able to appraise the results of medical research critically and to explain surgical professionalism and the basic principles of the safety of patients, doctors and health personnel.

cpl.isi: Mampu menerapkan dasar-dasar hubungan antar personal dan komunikasi profesi dengan menerapkan prinsip praktek bedah berbasis bukti
cpl.isi_en: Able to apply the basics of interpersonal relations and professional communication, applying the principles of evidence-based surgical practice.

cpl.isi: Mampu melakukan pemeriksaan klinik anamnesis dan pemeriksaan diagnostik, serta prosedur bedah
cpl.isi_en: Able to carry out clinical examination, history-taking, diagnostic examination and surgical procedures.

cpl.isi: Mampu melakukan dan mengaplikasikan ketrampilan bantuan hidup dasar pada trauma dan keterampilan klinis khusus di semua Divisi Bedah
cpl.isi_en: Able to perform and apply basic life support skills in trauma and specific clinical skills in all surgical divisions.

cpl.isi: Mengetahui dan memahami tentang integritas pribadi, kerjasama tim, komunikasi efektif terapeutik, berpikir kritis dan inovatif, dan empati dalam bidang ilmu bedah
cpl.isi_en: Knows and understands personal integrity, teamwork, effective therapeutic communication, critical and innovative thinking and empathy in surgery.

cpl.isi: Mampu mendemonstrasikan berbagai ketrampilan pemeriksaan klinik perioperative yang meliputi anamnesis, pemeriksaan fisik, interpretasi pemeriksaan alat bantu dan terapi perioperative pada penyakit dan kelainan bedah dari berbagai system organ tubuh sesuai dengan standar prosedur terbaik
cpl.isi_en: Able to demonstrate various perioperative clinical examination skills, including history-taking, physical examination, interpretation of supporting examinations and perioperative therapy for surgical diseases and disorders of the various organ systems, in accordance with the best standard procedures.

cpl.isi: Menegakkan diagnosis dan diagnosis banding penyakit di bidang ilmu penyakit dalam berdasarkan gejala, tanda, dan hasil pemeriksaan penunjang yang ditemukan;
cpl.isi_en: Establishes the diagnosis and differential diagnosis of diseases in internal medicine based on the symptoms, signs and results of supporting examinations.

cpl.isi: Merencanakan tata laksana pasien sesuai dengan latar belakang serta faktor-faktor yang ada pada pasien, keluarga, dan masyarakat sekitarnya serta melakukan konsultasi lebih lanjut ke tingkat subspesialis terkait pasien yang ditangani
cpl.isi_en: Plans patient management according to the background and the factors present in the patient, the family and the surrounding community, and carries out further consultation at the relevant subspecialty level for the patient concerned.

cpl.isi: Mampu menunjukkan sikap dan perilaku bedah yang baik
cpl.isi_en: Able to show good surgical attitude and behaviour.
